subject.title: fix: generated images no longer post twice

question: Before merging this protected PR, should maintainers require redacted after-fix Telegram proof of one generated-image delivery, or explicitly accept the mock qa-channel scenario as sufficient for this transport-visible regression?
rationale: The patch is channel-generic, but the reported user impact is a concrete Telegram double-send and the supplied PR evidence does not show the real affected transport after the fix.

options.title: Require Telegram proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram transcript, logs, terminal output, or short recording that shows one generated image delivery and the completion reply after the normal retry window.

options.title: Accept channel-agnostic QA proof
options.body: Record an explicit maintainer exception if the mock qa-channel scenario and focused regressions are considered sufficient evidence for this change.

recommendation.title: Require Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram transcript, logs, terminal output, or short recording that shows one generated image delivery and the completion reply after the normal retry window.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author has the most direct context for obtaining or explaining the missing after-fix delivery evidence; independent current-main ownership could not be traced.
